# Toast

Brief confirmation after an action ("Saved", "Call booked", "Message sent"), gone in 6 seconds.

`AleemDesignSystem_3de1ed.Toast` · Feedback

## Use

```jsx
<AleemDesignSystem_3de1ed.Toast>…</AleemDesignSystem_3de1ed.Toast>
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="AleemDesignSystem_3de1ed.Toast">…</x-import>
```

## Notes

Brief post-action confirmation on an ink surface (theme-stable). Place inside <ToastRegion>.

## Props (ToastProps)

| prop | type | note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `tone` | `'info' \| 'success' \| 'warning' \| 'danger'` | @default "info" |
| `title` | `React.ReactNode` |  |
| `children` | `React.ReactNode` |  |
| `action` | `React.ReactNode` | One inline action, e.g. <Button size="sm" variant="onInk">Undo</Button>. |
| `onDismiss` | `() => void` | Called when the timer ends or the user dismisses. Required for auto-dismiss. |
| `duration` | `number` | Milliseconds before auto-dismiss; 0 keeps it until dismissed. Pauses on hover/focus. @default 6000 |
| `dismissLabel` | `string` | @default "Dismiss" |

_Also accepts: React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement>._
